boards.school_name: North Carolina State University at Raleigh
boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented NC State traditions spanning campus expression, Wolfpack ceremonies, music, mascots and homecoming.

cards.title: Paint the Free Expression Tunnel
cards.subtitle: A student canvas beneath the rail tracks
cards.notes: Walk through the tunnel’s changing messages, then add a lawful, respectful design when campus guidelines and paint access allow.
cards.short_summary: A continually repainted public-expression tradition dating to the 1960s.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State describes the Free Expression Tunnel as an outlet for student creativity and expression since the 1960s.
cards.source_title: Get Oriented With the NC State Bucket List
cards.access_notes: Public pedestrian tunnel; follow posted campus policies and use only permitted materials.

cards.title: Leave a Handprint for Respect the Pack
cards.subtitle: Free Expression Tunnel during Wolfpack Welcome Weeks
cards.notes: During the annual Respect the Pack event, add your handprint to the mural near the tunnel entrance and read its inclusion message.
cards.short_summary: An annual handprint ritual supporting a campus culture of respect.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State says every student is invited to paint a handprint on the mural at the annual Respect the Pack event during Wolfpack Welcome Weeks.
cards.source_title: Get Oriented With the NC State Bucket List
cards.access_notes: Available during the scheduled Respect the Pack event; check Wolfpack Welcome Weeks programming.

cards.title: See the Memorial Belltower Lit Red
cards.subtitle: Memorial Belltower celebration tradition
cards.notes: Check university or athletics announcements after major Wolfpack achievements, then view the Belltower’s red illumination from public campus space.
cards.short_summary: The Belltower’s red lighting marks celebrated Wolfpack accomplishments.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State identifies lighting the Memorial Belltower red as a way the university celebrates athletics wins and faculty achievements.
cards.access_notes: Illumination occurs for selected achievements; it is visible from public outdoor areas.

cards.title: Turn the Block S Outward at Graduation
cards.subtitle: NC State commencement tradition
cards.notes: Eligible students can learn the ring symbols, wear the Block S inward before graduation, then turn it outward at commencement.
cards.short_summary: The ring orientation changes from student journey to alumni accomplishment.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State Alumni states students wear the Block S inward and turn it outward during university commencement after graduating.
cards.access_notes: Ring eligibility requires 60 undergraduate credits or graduate enrollment; purchasing a ring is optional.

cards.entity_name: Fellowship of the Ring at the Belltower
cards.title: Let a Class Ring Spend a Night in the Belltower
cards.subtitle: Memorial Belltower Shrine Room ceremony
cards.notes: If receiving an NC State ring, register for the Fellowship ceremony and collect it at the following Celebration of Pack Traditions.
cards.short_summary: Class rings are placed overnight in the Belltower’s Shrine Room.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State Alumni says participants may have their ring spend a night in the Memorial Belltower Shrine Room before it is presented the next day.
cards.access_notes: For class-ring recipients; dates and registration details are provided by the Student Alumni Association.

cards.title: Join Red and White Week
cards.subtitle: NC State’s annual homecoming celebration
cards.notes: Use the annual schedule to choose a campus event, wear red and white, and connect it with the homecoming football game.
cards.short_summary: A weeklong homecoming tradition that brings students and alumni together.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State describes Red and White Week as its annual homecoming celebration and a tradition uniting generations of the Wolfpack.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled annually in late October; individual events may have separate registration or ticket requirements.

cards.title: Learn “The Red and White Song”
cards.subtitle: NC State traditional song
cards.notes: Read the official lyrics before a game or campus gathering, then join the song when it is led by the Wolfpack community.
cards.short_summary: A traditional NC State song centered on the university’s red-and-white identity.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State Athletics lists “The Red and White Song” among the university’s traditional songs.
cards.access_notes: Commonly associated with Wolfpack events; follow venue entry and event rules.

cards.title: Sing the NC State Alma Mater
cards.subtitle: Traditional Wolfpack song
cards.notes: Save the official lyrics before attending a game, then join the Alma Mater when it is performed after the event.
cards.short_summary: A ceremonial song performed after NC State games.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State’s Global Training Initiative says the Alma Mater is a traditional vocal tune played after each game.
cards.source_title: How To Sound Like a Wolfpack Football Fan
cards.access_notes: Game attendance may require a ticket; lyrics are publicly available from NC State.

cards.title: Spot Tuffy III at a Wolfpack Event
cards.subtitle: NC State’s Tamaskan live mascot
cards.notes: Watch official athletics event information for appearances, and give Tuffy space while staff manage the live-mascot encounter.
cards.short_summary: Tuffy III continues NC State’s modern live-mascot tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State Athletics identifies Tuffy III as the university’s live mascot and dates the modern live-mascot tradition to 2010.
cards.access_notes: Appearances are event-dependent; follow staff instructions and do not approach without permission.

cards.entity_name: Howling Cow Ice Cream at the North Carolina State Fair
cards.title: Find Howling Cow at the State Fair
cards.subtitle: NC State dairy tradition at the North Carolina State Fair
cards.notes: When attending the fair, look for NC State’s dairy offering and connect the treat with the university’s long-running ice-cream history.
cards.short_summary: NC State ice cream has been a State Fair tradition since the 1970s.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State University Libraries reports that NC State ice cream has been a State Fair tradition for visitors since the 1970s.
cards.source_title: A Legen-dairy History of Ice Cream on Campus
cards.access_notes: State Fair admission and food purchases are required; availability follows the fair schedule.
